summary: Neverland's Lufia / Estpolis Denki RPG series, spanning two SNES titles, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance follow-ups, a Japan-only mobile Ancient Cave release, and a Nintendo DS action-RPG reimagining of Lufia II.

emulation.notes: Use accurate SNES emulation and original aspect ratio.

primary.version: North American SNES release via bsnes
primary.why: The first Lufia is a Super NES RPG with a later Japanese mobile-phone port; the SNES release is the complete English route and the best practical capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped SNES cartridge image in bsnes or original SNES hardware capture; use integer scaling and preserve the original 4:3 presentation.

entries.title: Lufia II: Rise of the Sinistrals

emulation.notes: Use accurate SNES emulation; consider documenting the European bug-fix differences if doing a comparison segment.

primary.version: North American SNES release via bsnes
primary.why: Lufia II is a Super NES prequel with puzzle-heavy dungeons; the North American SNES release gives the intended turn-based game in English at NTSC speed.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped SNES cartridge image in bsnes or Mesen. If comparing versions, note that the European release corrected some graphical and text glitches but runs as a PAL release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Lufia: Curse of the Sinistrals is a separate action-RPG reimagining, not a direct replacement for this turn-based game.

primary.why: The Legend Returns is the first handheld Lufia adventure and the continuation set after Fortress of Doom; Game Boy Color emulation gives the cleanest capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped Game Boy Color cartridge image in SameBoy or mGBA with integer scaling. The 3DS Virtual Console release is an official legacy option if already owned.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster documented; 3DS Virtual Console was a legacy rerelease.

primary.why: Estpolis Denki DX is documented as a Japan-only mobile-phone Lufia entry focused on the Ancient Cave scenario from Lufia II with original characters and enemies.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as a historical mobile entry unless supported Japanese handset/service files are legally available; do not plan it as a normal modern playthrough.

primary.version: Original Nintendo DS release via melonDS
primary.why: Curse of the Sinistrals is a Nintendo DS action-RPG reimagining of Lufia II with modified story, characters, 3D graphics, and action combat; it is distinct enough to play separately from the SNES original.
primary.how_to_play: Use original DS hardware capture or melonDS with a legally dumped cartridge image; configure dual-screen layout for readable stream capture.
